description: Inez directs a neighborhood choir and must decide whether to accept a pianist's barter proposal for accompaniment at two upcoming rehearsals, then settle the exchange, schedule, comparison offer, and performance setup with input from the people involved.

shared_context.S1: The neighborhood choir needs a pianist for two evening rehearsals before its spring sing-along.
shared_context.S2: Inez decides whether to accept an arrangement and sets the final terms.
shared_context.S3: Felix has offered to discuss accompanying the choir, and Rosa and Gabe are already involved in planning the rehearsals.
shared_context.S4: As a normal part of arranging choir events, Inez asks each person at the table to state any relevant offer terms, alternatives, availability, or hall requirements before she makes the final call.

PF1.text: Felix's exact proposal is to accompany two rehearsals on May 14 and May 16 from 18:00 to 20:00, in exchange for three 45-minute private voice-coaching sessions from Inez, with no cash payment.

PF2.text: Rosa has a confirmed alternative from pianist Dana: Dana would provide the same two evening rehearsals for exactly $300 cash.

PF3.text: Gabe knows that the hall's acoustic piano must be used because amplified instruments and brought-in keyboards are prohibited during the choir's rehearsals.

acceptance_conditions: Felix must be selected as the accompanist.
The settlement must cover exactly two rehearsals.
The rehearsals must be scheduled for May 14 and May 16 from 18:00 to 20:00.
The barter must provide Felix exactly three 45-minute private voice-coaching sessions and no cash payment.
The $300 cash alternative from Dana must be recorded for comparison.
The hall's acoustic piano must be specified, with no amplified instrument or brought-in keyboard.
The hall restriction must be cited as justification for the instrument setup.

content_checks.C4: decisions['barter_terms'] == 'three 45-minute private voice-coaching sessions for Felix; no cash payment'
content_checks.C6: decisions['instrument_setup'] == 'hall acoustic piano only; no amplified instrument or brought-in keyboard'
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'voice_coaching' and c['target'] == 'A2' and c['detail'] == 'three sessions of 45 minutes each' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Felix's exact proposal changes the selected partner to A2, fixes the number at two rehearsals, fixes the May 14 and May 16 18:00-20:00 schedule, and fixes the barter at three 45-minute coaching sessions with no cash.
Rosa's information changes the comparison record from no concrete benchmark to Dana's exact $300 cash offer for the same two rehearsals.
Gabe's hall rule changes the instrument choice to the hall acoustic piano only and excludes both amplification and a brought-in keyboard, while also supplying the fact that must be cited.
